note: Originals are kept untouched under sfx/ and music/. `pnpm audio:pack` (tools/pack-audio.mjs, needs ffmpeg) cuts the dead air before each effect, trims it to `longest` seconds, levels it to `peak` dBFS, fades the tail and writes mono mp3 files to public/audio/sfx/; each piece of music is lowered by its `gain` dB and written to public/audio/<name>.mp3. The mix between effects is set in src/audio/sfx.ts.
